Name: RealityCheck
Author: stanzhang
Description:
[b]欢迎来到鹈鹕镇税务局[/b]

欢迎，农场主。

经过多年的发展与建设，鹈鹕镇终于迎来了本应早已存在的重要机构：

[b]鹈鹕镇税务局。[/b]

与此同时，鹈鹕镇资产评估办公室、哈维诊所设立的鹈鹕镇医疗保险基金，以及全新的鹈鹕镇商品交易所也随之而来。

未来计划建设项目包括：

鹈鹕镇银行

（以上项目仍在审批阶段）

部分农场主可能会问：

“我种了这么多年地，为什么突然开始收我的钱？”

这是一个合理的问题。

但我们希望你不要将其理解为一种惩罚，或是对劳动成果的剥夺。

这只是一个正常社会运行所必需的基本机制。

城镇需要资金。
发展需要货币！

而更好的未来需要所有人的共同参与。

因此，自今日起，以下基础税费正式开始征收！
[heading][b]个人所得税[/b][/heading]
所得税是整个税务体系的基础。
目前，仅通过出货箱产生的收入会被记录并纳入征税范围。
因此，我们强烈建议各位农场主尽可能减少与本地商人之间的私人现金交易。
频繁的账外交易会给税务征收和统计工作带来不必要的困难。

（金税四期目前正在开发中，我们将严肃的打击违法的偷税漏税等情况，奉劝各位不要有侥幸心理）
[heading][b]房产税[/b][/heading]
房产税将通过综合评估模型计算。
评估内容包括：
[list]
[*]重置成本[/*]
[*]收益潜力价值[/*]
[*]功能溢价[/*]
[*]风险保障溢价[/*]
[*]折旧系数
 当然了还会有一些额外的行政费用要用来支持鹈鹕镇资产评估办公室，包括：[/*]
[*]行政管理费用[/*]
[*]文书处理费用[/*]
[/list]为了确保公平，我们采用了目前最先进的资产评估模型之一。
我们的目标是为每一位居民提供一个公平、透明且不会造成额外负担的税务体系。
我们不仅评估你的资产今天值多少钱。
我们同样评估它未来能够创造多少价值。
当然，我们也深知农民生活的不容易。
因此，我们特别推出了整个税务体系中最伟大的福利项目之一：
[heading][b]农业减免[/b][/heading]
该减免项目每周最高可减少 1000g 的税务负担。
减免额度完全取决于你的实际耕地面积。
耕地越多，获得的支持越多。
毕竟，如果有人值得获得特殊照顾，那应该是养活整个山谷的农场主。
[heading][b]经营资产税[/b][/heading]
随着农场规模不断扩大，部分生产资料将被纳入额外评估范围。

包括但不限于：
[list]
[*]小桶（Keg）[/*]
[*]腌菜罐（Preserves Jar）[/*]
[*]蜂房（Bee House）[/*]
[*]奶酪机（Cheese Press）[/*]
[*]以及其他商业化生产设备[/*]
[/list]请注意：

目前每种设备的前 20 台均享受免税待遇。
这是我们为本地农场主提供的众多扶持政策之一。
我们关心你。
我们爱你。
但请理解：
当你在农场摆放了一百个小桶时，
你经营的已经不再是一座农场而已了。
而是一家工业企业
资本家不同于农民，将有义务缴纳更多的税款。
[heading][b]医疗保险计划[/b][/heading]
在哈维诊所的协助下，所有居民均可自动加入鹈鹕镇医疗保险计划。
特别感谢哈维以及医疗保险基金对此项目的支持。

仅需每天 20g，
参保居民即可获得符合条件医疗费用 50% 的报销。
因为意外总会发生。

已经开始感到兴奋了吗？
很好。
因为我们带来的不仅仅是税收。
更是公共服务。
是社会福利。
是经济发展。
是属于所有人的更美好未来。

[size=5]鹈鹕镇商品交易所[/size]

随着市场经济的进一步发展，鹈鹕镇正式开放商品交易所。

农场主现在可以将资金存入交易所账户，并围绕部分农产品、加工品和商品开立合约。

你可以做多，也可以做空。

你可以提前平仓，也可以持有到期并进入交割。

合约价格将直接参考 Reality Check 的动态市场价格系统。

这意味着，市场价格不再只是报表里的一行数字。
它将真正影响你的收益、亏损、保证金、强平风险以及交割结果。

请注意：

商品交易所并不是一个稳赚不赔的福利系统。

合约交易需要保证金。
亏损可能导致强平。
交割失败可能产生违约金。
严重情况下，你甚至可能因此负债。

我们强烈建议所有农场主在进入交易所之前，认真阅读合约信息，并确认自己有足够的资金和商品储备。

当然，如果你坚持用最后一点钱去做空芒果，我们也不会阻止你。

鹈鹕镇尊重每一位居民自由走向破产的权利。

同时请记得定期查看邮箱。
税单、保险记录以及其他重要政府文件都将通过邮件送达。
此外，每位居民都将获得一份详细的经济报告。

[color=#ff0000]按下 [b]O 键[/b] 即可随时查看。[/color]

经济报告目前包含以下内容：

每日报告
季度报告
年度报告
税务报告
市场价格表
商品交易所入口


每份报告都包含详细的数据统计与分析信息，帮助你更好地了解自己的财务状况与经济活动。
我们强烈建议所有居民定期查阅这些报告。

一个了解自身财务状况的纳税人，才是一个合格的纳税人。

古人云：不偷税漏税的公民，才是好公民！

鹈鹕镇税务局祝愿您拥有一个丰盈富足的秋天。

[b][size=4]基本功能介绍[/size][/b]

[b]说白了非常简单，一个科学且庞大的税款征收途径+一个详细的直观的多维度财务报表+一个简单的医疗保险体系+一个终于可能会赔钱的游戏体验，o键打开财务报表，里面你想要的都有，报税单会在每周一上午发你邮箱，如果你噶了，医药费和医保详单以及补偿款将在第二天送到你的邮箱[/b]

[b]只要有smapi就能玩，偷偷给老乡们一点提示，这个提示只有中文部分有，那就是经营资产税才是最危险的，如果你非要用小桶酿美洲大树莓的话我估计你只能等我把银行系统做出来再贷款了，哦对了现在我修改后，你的钱已经可能是负的了，当你负债时所有收入进账瞬间就会被自动划扣，劝各位量力而行，尤其你那个破设备要是没有在产出价值就赶紧铲了吧，20个以上同类设备可就开始征税了[/b]


[b]祝老乡们玩得愉快～爱你们哦[/b]




[line]


Welcome, Farmers.

After years of development and growth, Pelican Town is finally welcoming one of the most important institutions it should have had all along:

The Pelican Town Tax Authority.

Alongside it comes the Pelican Town Property Assessment Office, Harvey’s Clinic’s Medical Insurance Fund, and the newly established Pelican Town Commodity Exchange.

Future plans may include:

Pelican Town Bank

(Pending approval.)


Some of you may be wondering:
“I’ve been farming for years. Why are you suddenly asking me for money?”
That’s a fair question.

But we hope you do not see this as confiscation, punishment, or an attempt to take away the fruits of your labor.
This is simply how a functioning society operates.

A town requires funding.
Development requires resources.
And a better future requires everyone’s participation.
Therefore, beginning today, the following basic taxes will be collected.

Income Tax
Income Tax serves as the foundation of the entire tax system.
At present, only income generated through the Shipping Bin is recorded and taxed.
For this reason, we strongly encourage all farmers to minimize private cash transactions with local merchants whenever possible.
Frequent off-the-books transactions make tax collection and statistical reporting unnecessarily difficult.

Property Tax
Property Tax is calculated through a comprehensive assessment process that includes:
Replacement Cost (RC)
Income Potential Value (IPV)
Utility Premium (UP)
Risk Shield Premium (RSP)
Depreciation Factors
Administrative Fees
Documentation Fees
To ensure fairness, we have adopted one of the most advanced tax assessment models currently available.
Our goal is to provide every resident with a tax system that is fair, transparent, and completely free of unnecessary burden.
We assess not only what your property is worth today.
We assess what it can become tomorrow.
Of course, we also understand that farming is hard work.
Which is why we proudly offer one of the most generous programs in the entire tax system:
Agricultural Deduction (AD).
This deduction can reduce your tax burden by up to 1,000g per week.
The amount you receive depends entirely on how much land you actively cultivate.
The more you farm, the more support you receive.
After all, if anyone deserves special treatment, it should probably be the farmers feeding the entire valley.

Business Property Tax
As your farming operation expands, certain productive assets may become subject to additional assessment.
This includes equipment such as:
Kegs
Preserves Jars
Bee Houses
Cheese Presses
And other commercial-scale production facilities.
Please note that the first 20 units of each equipment type are currently exempt from taxation.
This is one of the many benefits and support programs we proudly provide to local farmers.
We care about you.
We love you.
Please understand:
Once you own one hundred kegs, you are no longer running a small farm.
You are operating an industry.

Medical Insurance Program
In partnership with Harvey’s Clinic, all residents are automatically eligible to participate in the Pelican Town Medical Insurance Program.
Special thanks to Harvey and the Medical Insurance Fund for making this possible.
For only 20g per day, participants receive reimbursement for 50% of eligible medical expenses.
Because accidents happen.
And passing out in a mine should not automatically lead to financial ruin.

Feeling excited already?
Good.
Because what we are bringing is not simply taxation.
It is public service.
It is social welfare.
It is economic development.
It is a better future for everyone.

Commodity Exchange

With the further development of the local economy, Pelican Town has officially opened its Commodity Exchange.

Farmers can now deposit money into an exchange account and open commodity contracts based on selected crops, goods, and market items.

You can go long.
You can go short.
You can close before expiry.
Or you can hold until delivery.

Contract prices are based directly on Reality Check’s dynamic market price system.

This means market prices are no longer just numbers in a report.
They can now affect your profit, loss, margin, forced liquidation risk, and delivery outcome.

Please note:

The Commodity Exchange is not designed to be a guaranteed profit system.

Contracts require margin.
Losses may trigger forced liquidation.
Failed delivery may result in default penalties.
In serious cases, you may even end up in debt.

We strongly recommend that all farmers read contract details carefully before entering the exchange, and make sure they have enough money and goods prepared.

That said, if you insist on shorting mangoes with your last few gold, Pelican Town will not stop you.

We respect every resident’s freedom to go bankrupt.

Please also remember to check your mailbox regularly.
Tax statements, insurance records,  and other important government documents will all be delivered by mail.
In addition, every resident is provided with a detailed Economic Report.

[color=#ff0000]You can access your Economic Report at any time by pressing O.[/color]

This report currently includes:

Daily Report
Quarterly Report
Annual Report
Tax Report
Market Price Table
Commodity Exchange Entry


Each report contains detailed information designed to help you better understand your financial situation and economic activities.
We strongly encourage all citizens to review these reports regularly.
A well-informed taxpayer is a happy taxpayer.

Thank you for your cooperation.


[b][size=5]The Pelican Town Tax Authority wishes you a productive and prosperous farming season.[/size][/b]

[heading][b]Installation Instructions[/b][/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download Reality Check.[/*]
[*]Unzip the file.[/*]
[*]Place the RealityCheck folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]After the first launch, the mod will generate its config file automatically.
To open the financial report menu in game, press O.


[heading][b]Main Features[/b][/heading]
[b]Weekly Taxes[/b]

Reality Check adds a weekly tax system to Stardew Valley.
Current tax types include:
[list]
[*]Income Tax[/*]
[*]Property Tax[/*]
[*]Business Property Tax[/*]
[/list]Taxes are calculated through the week and settled as weekly obligations. After settlement, you will receive an official weekly tax notice in the mail.

[b]Custom Tax Notices[/b]

Weekly tax notices are shown through a custom document-style menu instead of the vanilla mail page.
Tax notices include:
[list]
[*]Tax period[/*]
[*]Settlement date[/*]
[*]Income Tax details[/*]
[*]Property Tax assessment summary[/*]
[*]Business Property Tax formulas[/*]
[*]Total tax due[/*]
[*]Signature confirmation[/*]
[/list]You must sign the notice before closing it with the close button. Esc is still available as a safety exit.

[b]Health Insurance[/b]

Reality Check adds a Harvey medical insurance system.
Current behavior:
[list]
[*]Daily premium: 20g[/*]
[*]Coverage rate: 50%[/*]
[*]Collapse or death-related medical costs are detected from actual money loss[/*]
[*]Insurance reimbursement is processed the next morning[/*]
[*]Harvey Medical Clinic sends a claim notice by mail[/*]
[*]Insurance coverage is recorded as an expense offset, not income[/*]
[/list][b]Financial Reports[/b]

The mod adds financial reports to help you understand where your money comes from and where it goes.
Reports include:
[list]
[*]Daily report[/*]
[*]Seasonal report[/*]
[*]Annual report[/*]
[*]Tax report[/*]
[*]Tax history[/*]
[*]Income details[/*]
[*]Expense details[/*]
[*]Outstanding balance[/*]
[/list]Reality Check is not meant to be a shop receipt tracker for every tiny purchase. It is meant to make long-term farm finances feel more real.

Dynamic Market Prices

Reality Check adds a dynamic market price system.

Many item prices can now fluctuate over time instead of staying fixed forever.

Market prices are recorded over time and can be viewed through the market price table.

Item hover prices will also try to use Reality Check’s market prices instead of vanilla fixed prices.

Commodity Exchange

Reality Check adds the Pelican Town Commodity Exchange.

The exchange allows players to open long or short commodity contracts using market prices from the dynamic price system.

Current exchange features include:

Independent exchange account
Deposits and withdrawals
Long and short contracts
Margin requirements
Daily mark-to-market settlement
Forced liquidation
Manual closing
Contract expiry
Physical delivery
Delivery storage
Delivery default
Exchange debt

This system is experimental and may still be adjusted in future versions.

[b]Outstanding Balance[/b]

If a Reality Check obligation cannot be paid immediately, the unpaid amount becomes outstanding balance.
Future income may be used to pay down outstanding balance automatically.

Manifest.Name: Reality Check
Manifest.Description: Adds weekly taxes, health insurance, financial reports, dynamic market prices, and the Pelican Town Commodity Exchange to make farm life a little less consequence-free.
